_comment: House changes to printed cards. Scryfall's data stays untouched in oracle-cards.json — this is applied on top when the oracle index is built, so `npm run sync:cards` keeps reporting only what Wizards changed and a re-sync never quietly undoes anything here. Every entry must name a card that is actually in the pool; a typo fails the build rather than doing nothing. `cmc` is never written by hand: it is recomputed from mana_cost, so the cost and the mana value cannot disagree.

cards.name: Ashiok's Erasure
cards.why: Two mana instead of four. A four-mana flash counterspell arrives a turn after the games in this format are decided.

cards.name: Jace's Erasure
cards.why: Mills two instead of one. One card per draw does not threaten a sixty card library inside the number of turns these games last.
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you draw a card, you may have target player mill two cards.

cards.name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
cards.why: Three mana instead of five, so it can be cast in a game that is over on turn four.

cards.name: Eternal Witness
cards.why: One green pip instead of two. Same mana value; the change is that a mostly blue deck can actually cast it.
